description: Return 5 to 25 USDC from the owner's OWN Hyperliquid (HyperCore) perps balance directly to the account's verified Arc home Safe via Relay: no Arbitrum and no withdraw3. The owner's HyperCore account must be in default mode and hold the amount as withdrawable. Before signing, the client verifies the solver-signed Relay order (HyperCore perps USDC in, exactly one Arc USDC payment to this Safe at or above a 1% floor, refunds only to the owner on HyperCore and the Safe on Arc), then builds and signs locally exactly two payloads: the Relay nonce mapping and one HyperCore sendAsset of the amount to Relay's pinned depository at the same nonce. Both are journaled before Felix submits them. Completion requires Felix's completion bound to this order and solver, and this client's own HyperCore ledger read of the send (the Arc credit is Felix's evidence, bound to the signed order and bounds, as in the app). No Felix fee is charged on this route. Reuse the same idempotency_key after a timeout; never start a new return to work around an uncertain one.

amount_usd.description: Exact USDC to send from HyperCore perps, 5 to 25, at most six decimals.

idempotency_key.description: Required workflow replay key. Reuse it to resume this exact return.

minimum_credit_usd.description: Optional: refuse unless Relay signs at least this Arc credit.

name: arc_home_hypercore_return
